notes.title: Adventure Portal Now Available! - Please Read
notes.content:
Adventure Portal is now available to the public and there are some points about the game to know before choosing to support the project.  The application is fully playable, current features are working, and it is still under development.  There will be occasional bugs, hang ups, or other weird behaviors that show up from time to time.  For the most part we enjoy and play AP weekly with few problems.  It's important that new players know and understand this before choosing to support the project ːsteamhappyː.  I want to make an easy to use, easy to learn, affordable utility for role players, and your support helps accelerate the process.  If you choose to support the project and give AP a try then I thank you and hope you enjoy it!  I posted a video walk through of all current features and how they operate above.

A couple of additional things to note about Adventure Portal before supporting (points about the current state and are subject to change in future updates):

- currently online only
- based on 5e gameplay rules only
- future updates to dm and player profiles might make current profile saves obsolete (will warn ahead of time)
- contains bugs!  (please check the forums for reporting)
- does not feature in game voice chat (yet)

If that didn't scare you away and you choose to support the project -- thank you for the support!

- Brian

notes.title: Update: Development Status (8/10/2018)
notes.content:
The game is was recently converted from Unity's uNet networking structure to Photon.   This was in an effort to fix some disconnect issues we were having during testing.   I am going to be testing the new networking framework this weekend and if all goes well I will be sending out the beta keys to all testers next week.  

-Brian

notes.title: Welcome To Adventure Portal Group
notes.content:
The Steam store page is finally public!   The Community Hub here  is going to be the primary forum to discuss the game with testers and the general public.  Thanks for checking out Adventure Portal !

-Brian
